features: Comfortable Backlit Keys and Scissor Mechanism
USB-C Port For Charging iPad Pro
Front And Back Protection For Travelling With iPad Pro
description: The Magic Keyboard is an amazing companion for iPad Pro 32.76 cm (12.9 inch). It features an incredible typing experience, a trackpad that opens up new ways to work with iPadOS, a USB‐C port for pass-through charging, and front and back protection. The Magic Keyboard has a floating cantilever design, allowing you to attach iPad Pro magnetically and to smoothly adjust it to the perfect viewing angle for you.
